item.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor and disability advocate RJ Mitte dies at 34
item.description: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate R.J. Mitte died on Monday at age 34, authorities and his representatives said. Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa told Associated Press she declared Mitte dead at about 1.30pm at what she believed was his home in Brownsville, Texas. She said she was unable to provide a cause but an autopsy will be performed. The actor lived with cerebral palsy. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor,... item.title: Costa Rica releases 13 white-lipped peccaries into a national park after an 18-year absence
item.description: Thirteen white-lipped peccaries were reintroduced to Piedras Blancas National Park after 18 years of absence. This project aims to restore ecological balance by benefiting local ecosystems and communities. Surveys confirmed the animal's disappearance, emphasizing the need for its reintroduction through local knowledge. The initiative also seeks to enhance ecotourism and environmental education in the region. Osa Conservation collaborates with various stakeholders to support conservation and community development. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: David Baldacci’s Feeding Body & Mind initiative distributes over 1 million books through food banks
item.description: David and Michelle Baldacci launched Feeding Body & Mind as a dual initiative to tackle food insecurity and improve literacy rates. This program gathers and disperses books through local food banks, allowing over a million families the opportunity to take home reading materials. By linking food support with literacy resources, it empowers families to enhance their reading skills and underscores the critical need for accessible literature in challenging times. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
